# pantechdynamics_iam_actions (Data Source)

Lists every action an access policy statement can name, such as instances:Stop, with what it allows. Any member may read it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every DNS action a statement can name.
data "pantechdynamics_iam_actions" "dns" {
  service = "dns"
}

output "dns_actions" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_iam_actions.dns.actions[*].action
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `service` (String) Only this service's actions, such as "instances" or "dns".

### Read-Only

- `actions` (Attributes List) The actions, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `id` (String) "iam_actions", or "iam_actions/<service>" when filtered.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) The action, <service>:<verb>, such as "instances:Stop".
- `description` (String) What the action allows.
- `read` (Boolean) Whether it only reads. Members get read actions without a policy while member_baseline is "read".
- `resource_types` (List of String) The kinds of resource the action applies to; empty for actions that are not about one resource.
- `service` (String) The service, such as "instances".
